title: Story premise ENT056: Two Reversals Make a Return
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (mechanical puzzles). Hook: Why is the pointer going the wrong way? Takeaway/theme: Count each reversal in a simple gear train.
description: A stage mechanic wants a pointer to turn clockwise, but two meshed toy gears reverse the input direction. They insert a third gear between input and pointer, turn the input clockwise, and watch the pointer rotate clockwise too, landing on a tiny applause sign.
